description: GridCal is an open energy model listed in openmod Initiative wiki, a community wiki of open energy models and data under the section "Open Models", published or maintained by as named on the fact sheet. GridCal is a research oriented power systems software. Coverage: user-defined regions (as stated on the fact sheet). The fact sheet classes it as: Transmission Network Model and Data (input and output),. Sectors: Electricity. Data availability is given as "all". The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is GPL-3.0 (as given on the fact sheet). Caveats: this record was written from the openmod wiki fact sheet, which was read; the source code and documentation were not opened, and the sheet may be out of date (it carries no update date). It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-openmod-initiative-wiki.
